storyTemplate.title: Sandbox Post-Apocalyptic Story
storyTemplate.description: A post-apocalyptic start: reach a fortified settlement and secure entry before the wasteland catches up.

messages.speaker: Narrator
messages.text:
The walls of Haven Nine rise from the dust like rusted cliffs.

A spotlight tracks you from the gatehouse. Behind you, the empty road runs back toward heat shimmer, broken cars, and the things that move after sunset.

A speaker crackles above the gate: state your business, show what you brought, or keep walking.

items.title: Earn Entry to Haven
items.summary: The player has reached a fortified settlement and needs to earn entry before night.
items.completion_criteria: Return yes only when Haven grants entry, denies entry with a concrete next condition, or the player earns enough trust to pass inside before night.
items.completion_instruction: Acknowledge the player's first concrete progress on earn entry to haven and keep the story open-ended after this single template objective is complete.
